race.comment: OMNIC (3) is flying, winning two in a row earlier in the campaign and following it up with two runner-up efforts since, beaten 1.3 lengths as favourite last time at Geelong. Turns around quickly here and is rock-hard fit, drawn to force the pressure and out-stay them late. INVISIBLE MAGIC (4) is coming off a narrow win here last time over an in-form Electric Elvis. That's good form, with luck from the inside she'll be hard to hold out. MIKE'S HOPE (8) missed the frame two back but was a lot better last time when third over 1600m at Pakenham Synthetic. Is going okay and Shinn on is a positive, each way. ICARO (1) promising gelding who last start finished 2.5 lengths away in fourth over 1600m at Sandown-Lakeside. Can improve here.
